findings.finding: The plan asserts 'CLI keeps ONE verb (set-file-impact) with a new mutually-exclusive form' using --none, but the current dispatch infrastructure in _commands/__init__.py cannot handle flags. The set-file-impact command is registered in _REGISTRY (the simple fixed-positional dispatcher) and main() invokes it as `entry.func(*args[:entry.min_args])` — extra argv tokens including --none are silently dropped. Flag-parsing (--none, mutual-exclusion with json_array) requires either moving set-file-impact to _ARGV_REGISTRY (like create/edit/link/unlink) or adding a new variadic wrapper function. The plan does not specify this architectural change.

scenarios: Developer adds --none handling to leaf.set_file_impact but forgets to migrate the command to _ARGV_REGISTRY; the flag is silently swallowed by the dispatcher and the call succeeds as a no-op JSON parse of the missing second positional.
